scope: Audit this analyst memo against the supplied source files. Some statements can be correct, incorrect, or not identifiable; give item-level judgments, corrected calculations and implications for hypotheses.

items.claim: The ratio of average polarization between the spread scan and mean-phase scan is 71.90206; directly dividing their exported DOP means is valid.
The S1/S2/S3 norm is about one, so every row in both scans has degree of polarization 100%; the DOP variation is therefore impossible.
There are 102 spread-scan rows and 200 mean-phase-scan rows; this is not evidence of 302 independent replicate experiments.
These two calibration scans alone prove that a particular detector drift mechanism is responsible for the discrepancy.
